name: Akiflow
summary: Planner that consolidates tasks and calendars, with an AI assistant for time-blocking.
description: Akiflow collects tasks from other apps into one inbox, lets users time-block them on their calendars and includes an AI assistant that answers scheduling questions and books slots. It targets founders, operators and busy professionals. A seven-day free trial is offered; the Pro plan costs $19 per month or $16 per month billed yearly, with a student discount. Integrations bring tasks in from other apps into a single inbox.
